## Problem / Motivation

What business or user problem does this solve? (Helm favors changes that answer
"what business problem does this solve?")

## Proposed Solution

A clear description of what you'd like to happen.

## Governance & Safety Considerations

Does this involve any consequential action? If so, how is human approval and
auditability preserved? (See `docs/ai-safety.md` and `docs/governance.md`.)

## Alternatives Considered

Other approaches you thought about.

## Additional Context

Mockups, links, or references.
